pages.text: Hypertubes are tubes you travel through at speed. Connect entrances with tube blocks and anything that steps in is carried down the line. Create rotation powers the entrance.

Right-click a placed tube while holding another, then place the second to connect them. Tubes that are already placed can be linked the same way. A wrench changes how many segments a span uses. The angle and distance between two ends are limited.
pages.title: Building a line
Hypertube
pages.text: Hold a tube, right-click one already placed, then place the next.

An entrance needs at least 16 RPM to admit you, and faster rotation means faster travel. A wrench changes the mode, between manual lock (sneak to enter) and automatic lock. The escape key gets you out of a tube.
pages.title: Entrances
Hypertube Entrance
pages.text: Power it from the shaft. If it says not enough speed, spin it faster.

pages.title: Hypertube Accelerator
pages.text: Speeds up whoever passes. Right-click for Brake mode instead.

pages.title: Hypertube Splitter
pages.text: Joins up to three tubes. Travellers steer with movement keys. A wrench cycles Continue, which sends them down the side tubes, and Center, which goes straight.

pages.title: Tube Scanner
pages.text: Gives a signal while something travels the tube, 8 for babies, 15 for adults. Redstone Detector Attachments change modes remotely.

pages.title: Related
pages.text: Rotation and stress power the entrance. Trains are the long-haul option.
